verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's 'Coach' is a built-in AI assistant accessible directly inside the Lorikeet platform (as well as via Slack/Claude/ChatGPT/MCP) that users can delegate tasks to — diagnosing tickets, auditing knowledge bases, building workflows via natural language, running simulations, and even implementing improvements automatically on the user's behalf. This is well documented across multiple first-party pages describing concrete delegated actions (e.g. doc-48 'Coach can implement improvements on your behalf').  missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Coach's assistant behavior, and clearer distinction between autonomous action vs. suggestion-only mode.
